title: Public Storage 8-K Filing — 2026-04-06
summary: Public Storage Operating Company, a subsidiary of Public Storage, completed a $500 million offering of 5.000% Senior Notes due 2035 on April 6, 2026. The notes are issued by PSOC and guaranteed by the parent company Public Storage.
key_points: Public Storage completed a $500 million senior notes issuance on April 6, 2026
Notes bear interest at 5.000% per annum, accruing from April 6, 2026
Issuer is Public Storage Operating Company; guarantor is Public Storage (PSA)
Trustee is Computershare Trust Company, N.A.
Notes are listed on NYSE under symbol convention PSA/35
